What is Tally AMC, and why does your business need it?

A Tally Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) is a proactive service agreement that keeps your Tally software running efficiently all year. Instead of dealing with unexpected errors, downtime or data issues, you have expert support whenever you need it.

Whether it is fixing technical glitches, managing data, upgrading versions or training your staff, AMC is a safety net for your accounting system. It prevents disruptions, improves productivity and keeps your financial operations accurate and up to date.

If your business relies on Tally for daily accounting, GST filing, inventory and reporting, a reliable AMC partner is not just helpful. It is essential.

Frequently asked questions

What services are included in Tally AMC?

Your AMC includes remote support, troubleshooting, updates, performance optimisation and onsite visits, depending on the plan you choose.

Is onsite support included in all plans?

It depends on the plan. Tell us how you use Tally and we will confirm exactly what each plan covers.

How do I choose the right AMC plan?

Tell us how many people use Tally and how much support you need. We will recommend the plan that fits.

What is your response time?

Critical issues get priority response. Share your requirements and we will confirm the response time for your plan.

Do you provide training for staff?

Yes. User training and guidance are part of our AMC services.
